achievements.label: First Signal
achievements.description: Send a signal the station understands.

achievements.label: Lamp Keeper
achievements.description: Light all seven lamps on planet 1.

achievements.label: Learning From Static
achievements.description: Send a signal the station cannot understand, and keep going.

achievements.label: Sharp Ear
achievements.description: Check three or more notebook entries and have every one right.

achievements.label: Never Shown
achievements.description: Send a sign on planet 2 that no transmission ever showed you.

achievements.label: Full Glossary
achievements.description: Have every part of planet 2's signs written down correctly.

achievements.label: Patient Listener
achievements.description: Receive every transmission on both planets.

achievements.label: Small Signs
achievements.description: Have all three of planet 3's small signs written down correctly.
